name: exp014-m50m-50k
desc: m50m trunk (10L x d640 x 10H, ctx512, RoPE) at the 50k GPT-NeoX-style vocab, full OWT re-encoded with the FIXED tokenizer. 113.9M params. 20k-step CEILING with early stop armed (expect it to self-abort near the knee, ~step 6-8k). batch 16 x accum 2 = effective 32, matching prior m50m runs so bpb is comparable.
notes: PRECONDITION: data/openwebtext_combined_bpe_owt50kv2.bin must exist and verify 7/7 (python verify_tokens.py --bin data/openwebtext_combined_bpe_owt50kv2.bin --vocab references/pythia-50k-owt-v2/tokenizer.json --manifest). Do NOT arm this spec before that: the watchdog would launch a trainer against a missing tok_cache. --tokenizer is the LEGACY-format conversion (train.py loads BPETokenizer for vocab_size / bytes-per-token / samples); the token STREAM comes from the .bin, which was encoded by the HF tokenizer via hf_bpe_shim. Parity matters: a legacy re-derivation is NOT token-identical to the HF encoder (measured +0.05% on 2M chars), which is why the bin was encoded with the shim.
